description: Nicosia's motorised segmented street network - manually edited is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ana Ricchiardi, Ilaria Geddes (University of Cyprus). A dataset containing spatial and attribute data for motorized segmented street network. The extents of the datasets refer to the Urban morphological zone of Nicosia, and a buffer of 20 km around it. The motorised networks exclude all streets that are pedestrian-only and where cars are excluded. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
